content: Official NetBox plugin docs prescribe register_model_view and ViewTab for core-model tabs; ObjectView resolves Device view permission and restricts queryset before get_extra_context. Running NetBox 4.7.4-Docker-5.1.1 source confirms this. Import registration from PluginConfig.ready before core URL assembly, not only plugin URL import. Context7/ctx7 unavailable, used official docs and runtime source.
